component.name: Lite Go
component.summary: A light, fast browser with shields built in

description.p: Lite Go is a small browser written in Go. Pages are shown by the system's web engine (WebKitGTK), and Lite Go adds what keeps browsing light and private.

ul.li: Lite Shields: ads, trackers, cookie notices and fingerprinting blocked
Containers for separate sign-ins, private tabs and split view
Background tabs that sleep and unload to save memory
Sync with Lite for Android over your own network, with no servers
